title: Integrate homepage spiral stages and route components
objective: Replace the patch-like sequence of individually positioned homepage route cells with a deterministic open spiral that creates shared content stages and integrates headings, category actions, project actions, companion copy, color, form, and depth into one homepage system.
scope: shared route stages for categories and selected work
homepage route marker, action cell, and companion variants
deliverables: category stage with Automation and Datenanalyse on one level
selected-work stage with three projects on shared levels
route marker, action cell, and companion component variants
acceptance_checks: route creates shared stages instead of aligning every cell only by its own Y center
Automation and Datenanalyse read as one level while each remains a real link
all three selected projects read as one grouped stage without overlap
section headings are non-interactive route markers rather than card variants
companion copy is visibly and semantically associated with its action
the route uses global connector color and only local category activation
global UI colors and five category identities remain unchanged
content and focus remain above all route layers
no-JavaScript reading order and links remain functional
desktop render reviewed at 2048 by 942 and full-page height
tablet and smartphone media rules remain unchanged

result.summary: The homepage now uses two deterministic open-spiral stages. Section headings are non-interactive route markers, five category and project destinations are visible real-link membranes, and their companion copy remains outside the hit area. The route runs through back, middle, and front artwork bands, preserves all five local category activations, and exits the work stage without crossing its own windings.
checks: unique IDs and valid aria-describedby assertions
two route stages and five stage actions asserted
JavaScript executed in Firefox without a parse error

reviews.semantics-accessibility: pass for desktop: meaningful heading and DOM order, real links, valid companion associations, visible motionless focus, and functional no-JavaScript content
reviews.visual-integration: pass for desktop after fix round: coherent shared stages, no route self-crossing, preserved profile/contact activation, differentiated membranes, and consistent artwork/UI layering

known_deferred: narrow route-stage reflow and focus-clipping correction under the explicit desktop-first responsive policy
